newsitem.title: USA: Laserscope asks FDA to okay upgraded laser.
newsitem.headline: Laserscope asks FDA to okay upgraded laser.

text.p: Laserscope Inc on Thursday said it has requested approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the new, higher-powered version of its 800 Series Dual-Wavelength KTP/YAG Surgical Laser System.

The new configuration boosts KTP energy levels to 50 watts from the current 36, helping to shorten procedure times in a variety of applications including urology, gynecology, ear, nose and throat surgery, aesthetic and thoracic surgery.
If cleared, the new system will be available as a field upgrade to about 600 installed Laserscope 800 Series Surgical Laser Systems throughout the world.
